status: Initial engineering rules; human review and heldout evaluation pending

rules.sentence: you grant us a perpetual license to your content
rules.explanation: This statement grants a content license without an expiry date.

rules.sentence: the license to your content ends when you delete it
rules.explanation: This statement ends the content license when the content is deleted.

rules.sentence: we use your content to train artificial intelligence models
rules.explanation: This statement permits using your content for AI model training.

rules.sentence: your subscription renews automatically until you cancel
rules.explanation: Charges continue through automatic renewal until you cancel.
This statement rules out refunds for payments.

rules.sentence: you can cancel your subscription at any time
rules.explanation: This statement allows cancellation at any time; it does not promise a refund.

rules.sentence: we may change these terms without notice
rules.explanation: The terms may change without notifying you.

rules.sentence: we will notify you 30 days before material changes to these terms
rules.explanation: This statement promises 30 days of notice before material changes.

rules.sentence: you must resolve disputes through binding arbitration
rules.explanation: This statement requires binding arbitration for disputes.

rules.sentence: you waive your right to participate in a class action
rules.explanation: This statement waives participation in class actions.

rules.sentence: we may terminate your account without notice
rules.explanation: The account may be terminated without advance notice.

rules.sentence: you can export your data before closing your account
rules.explanation: This statement allows exporting your data before account closure.

rules.sentence: we provide no way to export your data
rules.explanation: This statement provides no way to export your data.
